reports.title: Senate committee Report: declare Mackenzie’s church a criminal organization
reports.description:
The Senate committee investigating the proliferation of religious organizations and circumstances leading to deaths in Shakahola Kilifi County has finally released its report.

Among its recommendations is that the Cabinet Secretary for Interior declare the Good News International Ministries, associated with Pastor Paul Mackenzie, as an organized criminal organization.

#TV47WeekendEdition

reports.title: Ripoti: Kanisa la Paul Mackenzie litangazwe kundi la kihalifu
reports.description:
Kamati maalum ya Seneti iliyokuwa inachunguza vifo vya Shakahola imetoa ripoti yake ikipendekeza kutangazwa kwa kanisa la Good News International la Paul Mackenzie kuwa kundi la kihalifu.

reports.title: Seneti yazuru kanisa la Pastor Ezekiel Odero la Good News International
reports.description:
Kamati ya seneti inayochunguza kuhusu vifo vya wafuasi wa kanisa la Good News International kwenye msitu wa shakahola kaunti ya kilifi , Leo hii ilifinya ziara kanisani kwake mhubiri tata Ezekiel Odero kwenye eneo la Mavueni, ambaye pia alishukiwa kushirikiana na mwenzake Paul Mackenzie, katika mafunzo ya itikadi kali za kidini.

reports.title: Senate Ad’hoc Committte on Shakahola deaths visit Pastor Ezekiel’s church
reports.description:
The senate Ad Hoc committee on Shakahola has set up camp at Pastor Ezekiel Odero’s mega-church in Mavueni, Kilifi county, to verify testimonies.

reports.title: Pastor Ezekiel denies links to Paul Mackenzie and Shakahola Massacre
reports.description:
Pastor Ezekiel Odero of New Life Prayer Centre and Church has defended himself on the allegations of extreme indoctrination and insisted he had no relations with Shakahola Massacre suspect Paul Mackenzie nor involvement with the Shakahola tragic happenings.
